title: Good Morning Song ☀️ | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: Good morning! The sun comes up and Nomi wakes up. She says good morning to Mummy at the window, to Daddy making pancakes, to Nana with the toast, to big brother Kofi and to Mango the cat, and they all stretch up high to the sun. A happy morning-routine sing-along for toddlers and preschoolers to start the day.
actions: Say good morning to everyone in your family
Stretch up high, up to the sun
credit: Original song by Tiny Tune Town: new words and music.
